summary: RE-TEST of the editorial composer fixes reported in iteration_29. Both critical bugs are FIXED and verified against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Updated /app/backend/tests/test_editorial_composer.py to reflect the new multi-pass + downgrade-to-medium contract, added explicit tests for FIX 2 (community present), FIX 4 (recycled slots never hero/large) and FIX 5 (first-four items follow template order). Full backend regression: 57/57 passed (test_editorial_composer + test_wave12_content_sources + test_wave12_final + test_wave12_ux + test_wave12_groups_ext). All 6 target public endpoints return 200.

minor.issue: podcast_pool is still hard-coded to [] and dataset pool is still built but not referenced by EDITORIAL_TEMPLATE. Non-blocking (composer now handles skips cleanly via cycling+downgrade), but they remain dead code paths from iteration_29.

critical_code_review_comments: _compose_editorial now correctly forces layout='medium' on any recycled slot — no possibility of a second hero. Verified live: layout_distribution={hero:1, medium:15, large:2, small:2}.
community_pool = _curated_pool('community', country=resolved, limit=per_pool) is now wired into pools dict and slot 10 emits a community item (LATAM curated).
Consider wiring real 'podcast' and removing 'dataset' pool build (dataset has no template slot). Not blocking.

verified_fixes.FIX_1_single_hero: PASS — hero_count=1 across multiple requests (test_recycled_slots_never_hero_or_large, test_layout_distribution_present).
verified_fixes.FIX_2_community_pool: PASS — community appears at index 8 in live response (test_community_pool_present).
verified_fixes.FIX_4_recycled_medium_only: PASS — items at indices >=10 all use layout='medium' when kinds recycle (test_template_order_respected_with_cycling, test_recycled_slots_never_hero_or_large).
verified_fixes.FIX_5_template_order: PASS — first 4 items = news(hero), job, event, user_post (test_first_four_items_follow_template).
